items.heading: A Student Who Searches Job
items.text: A Student Who Searches Job A Student Who Searches Job A student who searches job boards for "botany" finds very little. The same skills sit under other names. Read the ad words in the left column, then check which branch of your degree they come from.

items.heading: We Ranked These
items.text: We ranked these by how far a person can grow income and independence with skill and proof, not by how respected the title sounds. Plant data and mapping come first because one skill serves many clients. The plant businesses follow, since each has a real market and a layer you can own.

items.heading: Most Botany Pages Stop
items.text: Most botany pages stop at "start a nursery". Here is what each layer sells, what rules to check and the one number worth watching.

rows: Plant taxonomy: naming, collecting and mounting specimens
Botanical Survey of India, universities, museum and botanic garden projects
Many posts are project-based. Field travel is part of the job.
Plant pathologist, plant health, seed testing
Plant pathology and mycology: diseases, fungi, seed health
Seed and agri-input firms, testing labs, agricultural universities
Lab and field mix. Closest to the crop-protection side of agriculture.
Plant ecology: sampling plots, species lists, habitat maps
Environment consultancies, NGOs, forest and wildlife projects
Report writing and mapping matter as much as plant knowledge.
Raw drug identification, medicinal plant sourcing, quality officer
Ethnobotany and pharmacognosy: which plant, which part, how it is used
Herbal and AYUSH makers, exporters, raw drug traders
One wrong plant in a batch is a quality failure, so correct identification is the paid skill.

items.heading: A Dated Plant List
items.text: A dated plant list. Fifty or more plants from one campus or village patch, each with a photo, place and date, saved on a public platform. It is proof of identification skill.

items.heading: Ten Pressed and Labelled Specimens
items.text: Ten pressed and labelled specimens. Collected with care, named, and shown in photos. Ask a teacher to check the names.

items.heading: A Cuttings or Germination Log
items.text: A cuttings or germination log. Same conditions, a survival count and one line on what went wrong. A nursery owner reads this fast.

items.heading: A Culture Contamination Log
items.text: A culture contamination log. If you do lab work, record each batch and its failure rate. It shows honesty, which a unit owner values.
